question: In a certain code language, 'YOU’ is written as '71' and 'TOO' is written as '60'. How will 'SIT' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- the sum of the position value of the letters + 10

​So,

 
• 'YOU’ is written as '71'
